item.tib: bstan srung gza' bdud chen po'i bskang gsol 'dod 'byung gter phreng
item.coloph: ces pa'i dpal gsang 'dus gshen gyi bka' sdod zhing skyong gza' bdud chen po'i skong chung nyung 'dus 'dod 'byung gter phreng 'di yang / rig pa'i zlos gar gyis phyug pa'i skal bzang g.yung drung gis bskul ngor/ rgod rje rgya yi rus 'thob tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am/ g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa'i rgyal khams kyi khol po ba des/ gnam lo gsar tshes ris bkra stag gi bzhin ras ngom pa'i tshes la dga' ston rten 'brel du yi ger bris pa 'dis kyang bstan dgra rtsad nas gcod cing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
